Package robbery.tool

Class Tools

java.lang.Object
robbery.tool.Tools
public class Tools extends Object
Represents a usable tool in the Robbery plugin.

Each tool has:

  • A name
  • A colored display name
  • A speed/damage multiplier
  • An associated Bukkit Material
  • A price (integer)

The class also provides a method to generate an ItemStack representing this tool with a formatted display name and lore.
